blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively refining partially masked sequences rather than by
strict left-to-right next-token prediction ( Austin et al., 2021a ; Lou et al., 2023 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Nie et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . Efficient dLLM inference therefore often reuses KV states across denoising steps, as in the prefix and dual cache modes of Fast-dLLM ( Wu et al., 2025 ) and adaptive cache updates in dLLM-Cache ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . This makes KV cache compression a natural next step, but it also changes the assumptions behind standard autoregressive (AR) KV cache quantization.
blocks.zh:
扩散语言模型(dLLMs)通过迭代地精炼部分被遮蔽的序列而不是由
严格从左到右的下接吻预测(Austin等,2021a;Lou等,2023;Sahoo等,2024;Shi等,2017-2010; 2024; Nie等,2026; Ye等,2025.). 因此,高效 dLLM 推论经常重复使用 KV 状态,跨越去诺步骤,如快克-dLLM的前缀和双缓存模式(Wu等,2025年)和可适应缓存更新 dLLM-Cache(Liu等,2025年). 这使得KV缓存压缩成为了自然的下一步,但也改变了标准自旋(AR)KV缓存量化背后的假设.

blocks.en:
In AR decoding, cached prefix states are exact under causal self-attention ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) : future
generated tokens do not change the key and value states of previous tokens. In dLLM decoding, layers use bidirectional
self-attention over the current masked sequence. When tokens inside the active block are revealed, prefix or suffix
token states can also change under full recomputation. Cache reuse avoids this recomputation by keeping selected
regions fixed, so the reused cache is an approximation to the full-recompute cache. Figure 1 (b)
illustrates this difference.

生成的令牌不会改变以往令牌的键和值状态。 dLLM 解码时, 层使用双向
对当前被掩盖的序列的自我关注. 当活动块内的符号被显示时, 前缀或后缀
符号状态也可以在完全重算下改变. 缓存再利用通过保留选中内容避免重算
区域被固定,所以再利用的缓存是完全重算缓存的近似. 图1(b)
说明这种差异。

blocks.en:
This difference makes direct AR-to-dLLM transfer unreliable. AR KV quantizers such as KIVI ( Liu et al., 2024 ) and
KVQuant ( Hooper et al., 2024 ) are usually motivated as approximating an unquantized reference cache with fewer
bits. In a dLLM cache-reuse path, quantization is applied to a cache that may already differ from full recomputation.
The deployed cache therefore contains both cache-reuse error and quantization error. Reducing reconstruction error of
the reused cache alone may not preserve attention patterns, token scores, or final task decisions.
blocks.zh:
这种差异使得直接AR-到dLLM传输不可靠. AR KV等定量剂,如KIVI (Liu等,2024年)和
KVQuant(Hooper等人,2024年)的动机通常为近似于一个数量较少的参考缓存
位数。 在 dLLM 缓存-再用路径中,对可能已经不同于完全重算的缓存进行定量处理.
因此,所部署的缓存既包含缓存-再用错误,也包含定量错误. 减少重建错误
仅是再利用的缓存可能无法保存注意模式、符号分数或最终任务决定。

blocks.en:
This setting creates two practical challenges. First, calibration data must reflect masked denoising states rather than
only complete prompt-answer sequences, because the same final answer can be reached through different reveal orders.
Second, the quantization objective should be tied to model behavior. This is especially important for K caches, where a
small numerical perturbation can shift attention mass among reused and recomputed tokens.
blocks.zh:
这种环境造成了两个实际的挑战。 首先,校正数据必须反映蒙蔽的去诺状态,而不是
只有完整的即时回答序列,因为同一个最终答案可以通过不同的揭示命令得到.
第二,量化目标应与模式行为挂钩. 这对 K 缓存尤其重要, 其中
小数字扰动可以在再利用和再计算符号中转移注意力质量。

blocks.en:
To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of KV cache quantization for dLLMs. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to a
unified Fast-dLLM cache interface and evaluate them under prefix and dual cache reuse. We then introduce TRACE, a
trajectory reconstruction procedure that assigns each answer token in a prompt-answer pair to a legal reveal step under
the dLLM block schedule. These reconstructed denoising states provide calibration data that matches masked iterative
decoding without storing full multi-step logits or KV caches. Figure 2 summarizes how this
trajectory construction supports offline policy fitting and online cache quantization.

统一快取-dLLM缓存接口,并在前缀和双重缓存再用下对其进行评价. 然后我们介绍TRACE,a

轨迹构造支持离线政策配置和在线缓存量化。

Building on this calibration, dLLM-KVQ selects a small set of K-cache entries to keep in high precision. The policy is
chosen per model, cache mode, bit-width, and layer using output- and attention-level metrics measured on reconstructed
trajectories. At inference time, it uses only information available from the block-initial forward pass, while the V
cache follows a standard low-bit quantize-dequantize path. Across LLaDA-Instruct and Dream-Base-7B on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and
MBPP, dLLM-KVQ obtains the highest average score among the evaluated quantized methods in the reported 4-bit and
2-bit prefix/dual settings.

blocks.en: The paper makes four contributions: • We formulate dLLM KV cache quantization under cache reuse and separate cache-reuse error from quantization error. • We propose TRACE to reconstruct dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs for calibration. • We propose dLLM-KVQ to select per-layer high-precision K-token budgets from behavior metrics and apply them using only block-initial information. • We show that dLLM-KVQ obtains the best four-task average among quantized methods across all reported models, cache modes, and bit-widths.

blocks.en: 3 Why dLLM KV Cache Quantization Is Different
blocks.zh: 3 为什么 dLLM KV 快取量 不一样

blocks.en:
KV cache quantization for autoregressive (AR) LLMs is usually framed as a reconstruction problem ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Hooper et al., 2024 ) : the unquantized cache is the reference cache, and the quantizer should
approximate it with less memory. For diffusion language models
(dLLMs), this view is incomplete. dLLM cache methods such as Fast-dLLM accelerate dLLM decoding by reusing cache states
computed by a block-initial forward pass, which are approximations to full recomputation ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . Our quantization study is applied on top of this cache
reuse mechanism. Therefore, the cache to be quantized may already differ from the cache that full recomputation would
produce. This section defines this difference and explains why it changes the quantization problem.
blocks.zh:
KV缓存为自递性(AR)LLMS的分解通常被设定为重建问题(Liu等,2024;Hooper等,2024):未分解的分解缓存为参考缓存,分解器应当
以较少的记忆来估计. 用于传播语言模型
(dLLMs),此视图不完整. dLLM 缓存方法,例如通过重用缓存状态来加速 dLLM 解码
按区块-首发出入口计算,相当于完全重算(Wu等,2025;Liu等,2025)。 我们的量化研究被应用在这个缓存上
复用机制。 因此,待量化的缓存可能已经不同于完全重算将产生的缓存
生产。 本节定义了这一差异,并解释了为何它会改变量化问题.

blocks.en: 4 dLLM-KVQ

blocks.en:
Section 3 shows that dLLM cache quantization must handle cache-reuse error in addition to ordinary
quantization error. dLLM-KVQ addresses this with a calibration-and-deployment design. The offline stage reconstructs
likely dLLM decoding trajectories and uses them to choose which K-cache entries stay in high precision. The online stage then
applies this policy to the cache states produced by the block-initial forward pass and reused by the cache mechanism.
Thus full recomputation is used only for calibration analysis, not during deployment.
Figure 2 shows the full pipeline.

blocks.en:
The design goal is behavior preservation under cache reuse, especially stable attention choices. K states enter the
query-key scores that define attention weights, while V states are read only after those weights are chosen. K
quantization can therefore redirect attention across reused and recomputed positions; V quantization perturbs the
content at positions already selected by attention. dLLM-KVQ accordingly spends the adaptive high-precision budget on
K and keeps V on a conservative low-bit QDQ path.

blocks.en: 6 Related Works
blocks.zh: 6 相关工程

blocks.en:
Diffusion and masked language models generate text through iterative denoising rather than causal next-token
prediction ( Lou et al., 2023 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) . Recent systems such as LLaDA and Dream show that
bidirectional masked denoising can support general language, math, and code tasks at LLM scale ( Nie et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . Fast-dLLM, dLLM-Cache, and Block Diffusion reduce the repeated full-sequence
computation required by iterative denoising through block-wise generation, cache reuse, adaptive updates, or parallel
token sampling ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Arriola et al., 2025 ) . These acceleration methods differ in schedule, but
they share the issue studied in this paper: reused KV states are approximate because bidirectional token
representations can change after later tokens are revealed. dLLM-KVQ is orthogonal to these systems and quantizes the
reused cache states they produce.

blocks.en:
LLM compression has been extensively studied through post-training weight and activation quantization, including
methods such as SmoothQuant, GPTQ, and AWQ ( Xiao et al., 2023 ; Frantar et al., 2022 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) . KV cache
quantization targets a different bottleneck: the activation memory that grows with context length, batch size, and
generation length during inference. KIVI and KVQuant are representative AR KV-cache quantizers, using asymmetric K/V
granularity, pre-RoPE key quantization, non-uniform datatypes, and outlier handling ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Hooper et al., 2024 ) . These methods assume cached prefix states are exact reference states under
causal attention. In dLLMs, the reused cache is itself an approximation to full recomputation. We therefore adapt KIVI
and KVQuant as baselines, but evaluate quantization with behavior-level metrics and introduce trajectory-calibrated
K-side quantization under stale-cache mismatch.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We studied KV cache quantization for diffusion language models and show that cache reuse shifts the objective from cache reconstruction to behavior preservation under reuse-induced error. TRACE calibrates denoising trajectories, and dLLM-KVQ uses these states to select K-side policies with conservative V-side quantize-dequantize. Results on LLaDA and Dream, together with LLaDA trajectory diagnostics, support dLLM-KVQ as a reproducible dLLM cache-quantization algorithm.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了 KV 缓存量化用于扩散语言模型,并显示缓存再利用将目标从缓存重建转移到了再利用引起的错误下的行为保存. TRACE校正会去去Noising traces,而dLLM-KVQ使用这些状态来选择带有保守V-side quantize-dequantize的K-side政策. 关于LLaDA和Dream的结果,连同LLaDA轨迹诊断,支持dLLM-KVQ作为可再生的dLLLM缓存-定量算法.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en:
The evaluation covers two representative diffusion language models, two Fast-dLLM cache modes, four tasks, and both
4-bit and 2-bit KV-cache settings. It does not exhaust all decoding schedules, sequence lengths, batch sizes, or future
dLLM architectures. These extensions are natural follow-up settings for calibration and policy selection rather than
changes to the core cache-reuse error studied here.

更改此处研究的核心缓存-再使用错误 。

blocks.en:
dLLM-KVQ spends its adaptive budget on K states because the method is designed to preserve attention behavior under
cache reuse. The V cache is therefore kept on a simple low-bit quantize-dequantize path. More specialized V-side policies may provide
additional gains, especially in regimes where value reconstruction rather than attention stability becomes the dominant
factor, but they are orthogonal to the main K-side behavior-preservation result. Finally, this paper reports task
quality and effective-bit accounting. End-to-end serving speed depends on fused low-bit attention kernels and runtime
integration, as in prior LLM serving and quantized-serving systems ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) .

MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021b ) . We use the lm-eval task definitions ( Gao et al., 2024 ) with 5-shot GSM8K, 4-shot MATH,
0-shot HumanEval, and 3-shot MBPP. Experiments are run on NVIDIA H200 140GB GPUs.

blocks.en: A.2 Responsible Research and Reproducibility Details
blocks.zh: A.2 负责任的研究和可复制性细节

blocks.en:
This paper studies inference-time KV-cache quantization. We use publicly released pretrained checkpoints, GSAI-ML/LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-org/Dream-v0-Base-7B , and do not train new base models. The model
cards list MIT for LLaDA and Apache-2.0 for Dream; the LLaDA card reports 8B parameters, and the Dream checkpoint is a
7B-class diffusion language model whose current model card reports an 8B parameter scale. We use Fast-dLLM, KIVI,
KVQuant, Hugging Face Transformers, Accelerate, and lm-eval ; KIVI and KVQuant are modified only to run through
the same Fast-dLLM cache wrapper described in Appendix A.3 . Any released code or policy files
are intended for research evaluation of dLLM cache compression. We do not redistribute pretrained model weights,
benchmark datasets, or the public calibration corpora.

基准数据集,或公共校正公司。

All evaluation benchmarks are public English-language or Python-code benchmarks used through lm-eval . We

blocks.en: A.3 KIVI and KVQuant Adaptations
blocks.zh: A.3 科学研究院和KVQuant 适应

blocks.en:
We port KIVI and KVQuant into the same Fast-dLLM cache interface used by dLLM-KVQ. All quantizers wrap the model with a
common cache wrapper: before a forward pass, quantized past_key_values are dequantized; after a cache-producing
forward pass, the returned K/V cache is quantized and stored. The wrapper receives the current block range and cache
mode, so the same quantizer code is used for prefix and dual cache reuse.
blocks.zh:
我们把KIVI和KVQuant移植到由dLLM-KVQ使用的同一种快DLLM缓存接口. 所有分数器都用一个
常见缓存包:在前方通过前,将已定量的 past_key_值分解;在缓存生成后
前传,返回的 K/V 缓存被量化并存储。 包装器接收当前块范围和缓存
模式,因此在前缀和双重缓存再利用时使用相同的定量码.

blocks.en:
For KIVI, we keep the asymmetric granularity of the original method: K is quantized along the token dimension with
channel-wise scales, and V is quantized along the channel dimension with token-wise scales. The original AR decoding
implementation maintains residual high-precision tails during generation. In our Fast-dLLM adaptation, cache states are
stored at block-level reuse points, so the main experiments disable the residual tail with residual_length=0 and use group size 32. This makes the KIVI baseline a direct low-bit quantization of the
reused dLLM cache rather than a separate AR streaming-cache policy.
blocks.zh:
对于KIVI,我们保持了原始方法的不对称颗粒性: K 沿着符号维度被量化
频道天平,而V则被以符号天平沿频道维度进行定量. 最初的AR解码
实施过程中保持残余高精度尾部。 在我们的快速dLLM适应中,缓存状态是
被储存在区块级再利用点上,所以主要实验会以残长=0来使残尾停用并使用组大小为32. 这使得KIVI基线直接被低位量化
重用 dLLM 缓存而非单独的 AR 流- 缓存策略 。

blocks.en:
For KVQuant, we fit a bit-width-specific calibration state from collected Fast-dLLM KV cache traces. The calibration
script stores native cache samples and, when enabled, Fisher-style activation-gradient weights. It also reshapes Dream’s
3D cache layout into the common [batch, heads, tokens, dim] layout used by the calibration code. The deployed
quantizer loads the fitted per-layer key/value state, applies non-uniform lookup quantization, keeps sparse outlier
handling enabled with sparsity threshold 0.99, and sets first_few_fp16=0 . KVQuant uses pre-RoPE cache keys
when the model exposes that cache-position mode; the other reported quantizers use the native post-RoPE cache path.
blocks.zh:
对于KVQuant,我们符合从所收集的快取dLLM KV缓存痕迹中取出的一个位宽特异性的校正状态. 校正
脚本存储了本地缓存样本,并在启用时存储了Fisher式活化-梯度重. 也重塑了梦想
3D缓存布局入到校正码使用的普通[批,头,指,暗]布局. 部署人员
装入每层密钥/值状态的量子, 应用非统一型的量子检查, 保持稀有的超值
处理时启用了相接阈值0.99,并设置了先行_few_fp16=0. KVQuant 使用预 RoPE 缓存密钥
当模型暴露出缓存-位置模式时;其他已报告的分解器使用原生后RoPE缓存路径.

blocks.en: A.4 Quantization Granularity
blocks.zh: A.4 量化

blocks.en:
dLLM-KVQ follows the K/V granularity used by representative AR KV-cache quantizers ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Hooper et al., 2024 ) .
Key activations show channel-wise structure across tokens, while value activations are better represented by token-wise
channel grouping. Accordingly, K is quantized with channel-wise scales over token groups, and V is quantized with
token-wise scales over channel groups. The dLLM-specific part of dLLM-KVQ is the policy that decides which K-cache
tokens stay in high precision, not a new basic QDQ format.
blocks.zh:
dLLM-KVQ遵循具有代表性的AR KV-cache分解剂使用的K/V颗粒(Liu等,2024;Hooper等,2024).
键激活显示跨符符的频道结构,而值激活则以符符符更好地代表
频道分组. 因此,K按频道比符号组的比分进行量化,而V按
频道组的平面。 dLLM-KVQ中特定部分的dLLLM是决定哪个K缓存的政策.
符号保持高精度,而不是新的基本QDQ格式。

blocks.en: A.6 Policy Diagnostics and Selection
blocks.zh: A.6 政策诊断和选择

blocks.en:
Diagnostics compare each candidate against a baseline that quantizes all K tokens in the reused cache to low bit-width.
Each paired record uses the same cache mode, sample index, block, step, and layer. Lower-is-better metrics include
centered score distance and attention KL. Higher-is-better metrics include top-1 key agreement, top- K K key recall, and
score cosine. Each metric is converted to a signed improvement over this baseline before policy selection.

诊断将每个候选物与一个基线进行比较,该基线将再利用缓存中的所有克令牌被分解为低位宽.

blocks.en:
The default candidate set uses three token scores available at inference time: attention from the block-initial forward pass, K
quantization error, and the normalized product of the two. The high-precision K-token budget per group is chosen from { 0 , 1 , 2 , 4 } \{0,1,2,4\} . The current selection
weights are 1.0 1.0 for centered score distance, 0.001 0.001 for attention KL, 0.10 0.10 for top-1 agreement, and 0.05 0.05 for

a centered-score win-rate gate, and stays within the effective K bit-width cap. The main experiments use a win-rate
gate of 0.5 0.5 and an effective K bit-width cap of 4.9 4.9 .

blocks.en: A.7 Online Quantization Details
blocks.zh: A.7 在线量化细节

blocks.en:
K-cache quantization uses contiguous groups along the token dimension. For each group, the selected policy ranks tokens
by the chosen score and keeps the top- p p tokens in high precision. The remaining tokens are quantized with low-bit
min-max QDQ. The high-precision tokens are excluded from min and max estimation so that outliers do not enlarge the
low-bit quantization interval for the remaining tokens. If p = 0 p=0 , the operator reduces to ordinary KIVI-style K
quantization.

以所选分数来表示,并保持高精度的p符号。 其余的代号以低位量化
min-max QDQ. (中文(简体) ). 高精度符号不包含在分数和最大值的估算中,这样外部值就不会扩大

method focuses on deciding which K tokens remain in high precision.
